root_idea.summary: The root centers on following or coming after something, whether physically, sequentially, imitatively, or by adherence.
root_idea.development: From following and succession developed the usages for reciting a text in sequence, following revealed guidance in knowledge and action, and referring to what remains after something else.

senses.definition: To follow, come after, or succeed another in sequence, position, or rank.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage includes following in a physical or figurative sense, as in the moon following the sun.

senses.definition: To read, recite, rehearse, or present a revealed text, passage, or account.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially with revealed scripture and with presenting or recounting a narrative; the form may be active or passive and may take a direct object or occur with عَلَى.

senses.definition: To follow revealed scripture by understanding it and acting according to its commands and guidance.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the scripture-oriented sense of تلاوة: recitation is accompanied by faithful adherence, knowledge, and practice rather than being mere vocal reading.

senses.definition: Recitation of revealed scripture with attentive following and observance of its guidance.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِ, the verbal noun includes following the scripture through knowledge and action, not only reading it aloud.

senses.definition: One who recites or rehearses praise.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the feminine plural تَالِيَات, interpreted as those who recite divine praise; the interpretation includes angels or angels and others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To imitate another and follow that person's actions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general imitation or following usage, distinct from merely coming after someone physically.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive, bring, or gather camels together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is explained as arising because the driver follows the animals being driven.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To say false things against someone or attribute a lie to that person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional عَلَى construction meaning to lie about or against someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back, lag behind, withdraw from someone, or leave someone without aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a contrary-looking Classical branch in which the one who was accompanying another remains behind or abandons him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A follower; especially a young animal that follows its mother, including a young mule, ass, camel, sheep, or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal sense may refer to a weaned young that remains with or follows its mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain as a remainder of a due, claim, month, or other allotted matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for something still remaining to someone or remaining of a period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand or seek to obtain the remainder of a right, due, need, or desired thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II usage emphasizes seeking the outstanding portion until it is obtained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one prayer follow another, especially to follow an obligatory prayer with a supererogatory one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form II prayer construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand erect for prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported Classical usage of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accomplish or fulfill a vow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form II usage with a vow as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be at the last gasp or near death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative or situational usage of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To alternate with or relieve another in singing or in a task by taking up the strain when the other cannot continue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III construction may refer to mutual assistance in singing or work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to follow; of a mother animal, to have its young following her.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form IV causative may describe a person followed by children or an animal followed by its young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To get ahead of, outstrip, or precede someone after pursuing him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning develops from following until one has overtaken the person followed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a remainder of one's due, claim, or needed matter with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for an outstanding portion deliberately left in another person's possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To transfer a debt or claim to another person, shifting responsibility for payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transferred obligation is referred to the person who assumes responsibility for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a bond, obligation, or token securing that person's protection and safe conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The token could be an arrow bearing the giver's name, or another recognized object such as a sandal, shown to a tribe to obtain protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone a follower or companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV extension of causing someone to follow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek a right, due, or desired thing repeatedly, gradually, or at leisure until it is obtained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V usage emphasizes continued or stepwise pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or accumulate much wealth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form V usage without a necessary implication of gradual acquisition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow one another consecutively; to occur in succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of events, things, horses, or horsemen arriving one after another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invite or cause someone or something to follow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X construction may describe making a person follow or inviting him to follow a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look for, expect, await, or wait for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X usage involving expectation or waiting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand the transfer of a debt or claim from one responsible person to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the active-participial and verbal usage associated with shifting responsibility for an obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that follows another, or a follower of another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can be used generally for what comes after or remains in another's following.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or lofty in measure or stature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate adjectival usage, as in describing someone or something as high in rank or extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who follows persistently or incessantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive nominal pattern describing continued following.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who uses many oaths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported descriptive usage of the adjective or noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person possessing much wealth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate reported meaning of the same headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder or remnant of a thing, right, due, debt, or desired matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also refer figuratively to remaining youthfulness or the last surviving member of a class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That which occurs after something else; subsequently to.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction تَلِيَّةَ كَذَا for an event occurring after another event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small boat that follows a larger vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun explained through the boat's following relationship to the larger ship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who reads, studies, or recites the Quran frequently, or who frequently follows and acts upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive noun for habitual engagement with the Quran.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who or that which follows, goes, or walks behind or after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle may describe immediate or effective following, bodily or figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fourth of ten horses started together in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical racing designation derived from ordinal succession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aldebaran, the star that follows the Pleiades.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical name based on the star's position after the Pleiades.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last or following stars, especially those seen last in the morning twilight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural astronomical usage; the exact group is described by its following or trailing position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last women traveling in vehicles on camels, and likewise the last camels in a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage for those or those animals bringing up the rear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hind parts, posteriors, or rumps; of a horse, its tail and hind legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun for the rear portion of a body or animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mother or female animal whose young follows her.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terms may be applied to a human mother, a she-camel, or a female wild animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female camel or similar animal that bears late in the breeding season, or is pregnant according to some explanations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence records variant explanations, including late bearing, pregnancy, and being heavy with pregnancy; the term is not restricted to one of these interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who relieves or assists another in singing or work by taking up the strain or task when the other cannot continue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The assistance may be performed with a high voice in singing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who sings to camels to urge or excite them onward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the participle in camel-driving contexts.

cautions: The root has a documented Classical branch in which تَلَا means to hold back or leave someone; this contrary-looking usage is kept separate from following and recitation.
The animal terms مُتْلٍ and مُتْلِيَةٌ have divergent reported explanations, including late bearing, pregnancy, and being heavy with pregnancy; no narrower interpretation is imposed.
Mufradat records an alternate reading تَبْلُوا at 10:30. That reading is not treated as a تلو occurrence because 10:30 is absent from the supplied QAC locations for this root.
